basis: Venue categories read from ACLU Protesters' Rights, June 8, 2026. These are public forum categories, not a finding that any particular parcel is available or a permit has been issued.

places.label: Public sidewalk
places.access: Keep pedestrian and vehicle access clear.

places.label: Public park
places.access: Use the public area without interfering with its ordinary use.

places.label: Public civic plaza
places.access: Keep access to the public building clear.
